title: Fulcrum
tagline: Fulcrum is an autonomous hybrid prediction market built on the Arc Network.
description:
Here is the English version of the summary, ready for your hackathon submission:

Project Name: FULCRUM

Abstract:

Fulcrum is the first autonomous hybrid prediction market built on the Arc Network, designed to solve liquidity fragmentation and user experience friction. In the current ecosystem, users are forced to choose between real asset ownership (Polygon/Polymarket) and high-speed leveraged trading. Fulcrum dismantles this barrier by utilizing a Python-based "AI Router Agent" that unifies two distinct execution engines within a single interface.

The system dynamically routes trades based on user preference:

Spot Trades (1x): The Agent simulates the Circle CCTP (Cross-Chain Transfer Protocol) infrastructure to securely bridge funds, ensuring real asset ownership from the counter-chain.

Leverage Trades (2x-5x): For high-risk appetite, funds never leave the Arc Network. The Agent executes instant Synthetic Positions via the SignalVault smart contract. This approach keeps liquidity efficient on Arc while maximizing transaction speed.
how_its_made: Security and solvency are guaranteed by an autonomous risk manager adhering to x402 Protocol standards. This Agent validates real-time data streams via verifiable micro-payments while monitoring leveraged positions 24/7 to trigger automatic liquidations, protecting the Liquidity Provider (LP) pool. Integrated with Privy for a gasless and wallet-less onboarding experience, Fulcrum represents the future of DeFi: capital-efficient, data-verified, and lightning-fast.
